file_insights.purpose: Audit documentation capturing baseline metrics before removing unused static file plugins
file_insights.insights: Comprehensive baseline audit document created to track before/after metrics for plugin removal optimization effort

patterns_discovered.description: 60 plugin directories from old admin template remain in staticfiles despite application using only Tabler, HTMX, and Alpine.js
patterns_discovered.evidence: Context section notes these are from old admin template and unused by application

patterns_discovered.description: Top 5 plugins (flag-icon, DataTables, jquery-ui-1.12.1, font-awesome, sweetalert) comprise approximately 13.5M out of 23M total plugin size
patterns_discovered.evidence: Detailed plugin sizes show flag-icon alone is 8.1M (35% of plugins directory)

patterns_discovered.description: Detailed audit created before deletion work to establish baseline metrics, enable impact measurement, and support rollback if needed
patterns_discovered.evidence: Comprehensive listing with dates, calculations, and context sections

gotchas_discovered.description: 60 unused plugin libraries represent potential security vulnerabilities from outdated versions that are no longer maintained
gotchas_discovered.impact: Dependency vulnerabilities could expose application even if plugins are not actively used
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Complete removal of plugin directory eliminates attack surface

gotchas_discovered.description: 23M of plugin files directly increases Docker image size and deployment artifact size unnecessarily
gotchas_discovered.impact: Slower deployments, larger image pulls, increased storage costs, longer CI/CD times
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Deletion will recover 23M space (41% of staticfiles)

gotchas_discovered.description: collectstatic operations process 60 unused plugin directories, slowing build pipelines
gotchas_discovered.impact: Every deployment runs collectstatic on unused files, wasting build time
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Removing plugins will significantly speed up collectstatic operations

approach_outcome.description: Document current staticfiles size and list all plugin directories
approach_outcome.approach: Created comprehensive audit document with size metrics, plugin listing, and impact analysis before proceeding with deletion
approach_outcome.deliverable: Detailed audit file with before-state documentation for measurement and validation

recommendations.rationale: Clear documentation establishes 41% size reduction opportunity (23M), eliminates security vulnerabilities from outdated libraries, and improves build performance
recommendations.next_steps: Execute deletion of ./staticfiles/plugins directory and validate that application functions with only Tabler, HTMX, and Alpine.js

recommendations.rationale: Document final metrics to confirm 23M reduction achieved and serve as validation of optimization
recommendations.next_steps: After deletion, create matching audit file to compare before/after metrics

recommendations.rationale: Ensure no hidden dependencies on removed plugins exist in application code
recommendations.next_steps: Run full test suite and manual smoke tests to confirm no plugin references remain

recommendations.rationale: Tabler, HTMX, and Alpine.js are pinned versions; ensure they're properly tracked in version control with appropriate lock mechanisms
recommendations.next_steps: Review package management approach for static vendor dependencies

recommendations.recommendation: Document removed plugins for future reference
recommendations.rationale: If legacy features requiring these plugins are ever resurrected, audit file will help restore them
recommendations.next_steps: Keep audit file as reference documentation in specs directory
